macros.name: aftersectionvspace
macros.doc: This command replaces the space inserted by a previous sectioning command with the \vspace{⟨distance⟩}.

macros.name: beforechapter
macros.doc: The \beforechapter hook inserts its contents at the beginning of page just before a chapter instead of spacing specified in the chapter declaration.

macros.name: bff
macros.doc: The \bff command tries to set everything bold.

macros.name: captionstyle
macros.doc: \captionstyle[⟨type⟩]{⟨style⟩} selects a style to be applied to the caption text.

macros.name: captiontagstyle
macros.doc: \captiontagstyle[⟨type⟩]{⟨style⟩} selects a style of caption tag: right or para.

macros.name: captiontagsuffix
macros.doc: \captiontagsuffix[⟨type⟩]{⟨suffix⟩} changes a suffix after caption tag.

macros.name: CaptionTagSuffix
macros.doc: The \CaptionTagSuffix{⟨suffix⟩} command specifies a default suffix inserted after a caption number tag.

macros.name: captionwidth
macros.doc: The \captionwidth[⟨type⟩]{⟨length⟩} specifies a caption width in \@tempdima. Default width is \linewidth.

macros.name: epigraphwidth
macros.doc: In \epigraphparameters, you can use the \epigraphwidth macro which contains a selected epigraph width.

macros.name: headingtag
macros.doc: The \headingtag{⟨tag⟩} modifier overrides a number tag in the next section.

macros.name: indentaftersection
macros.doc: The paragraph indentation after a display section is controlled with the \indentaftersection and \noindentaftersection commands. The first one allows and the last one suppresses indentation after section.

macros.name: newhangsectionstyle
macros.doc: creates a new hang-indented section style with the given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: newplainsectionstyle
macros.doc: creates a new paragraph-like section style with the given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: noheadingtag
macros.doc: The \noheadingtag modifier suppresses a number tag in the next section, but all other attendant actions are executed (writing to the aux-file and updating the running head).

macros.name: noindentaftersection
macros.doc: The paragraph indentation after a display section is controlled with the \indentaftersection and \noindentaftersection commands. The first one allows and the last one suppresses indentation after section.

macros.name: norunninghead
macros.doc: The \norunninghead modifier suppresses generation of running head for the next non-starred section, i.e. it skips the call of section mark command in the next section.

macros.name: norunningsuffix
macros.doc: The \norunningsuffix modifier applied in the parameter of running section removes a suffix after section title.

macros.name: NumberlineSuffix
macros.doc: The \NumberlineSuffix{⟨calc-suffix⟩}{⟨actual-suffix⟩} command allows customize a skip inserted after numbers in TOC-like entries.

macros.name: PnumPrototype
macros.doc: The \PnumPrototype{⟨prototype⟩} command is used for adjustment the right margin of the text of toc-entries in toc-lists.

macros.name: runinsectionskip
macros.doc: This command is useful in the ⟨action⟩ parameter of the toc-entry declaration to produce the skip before a toc-entry equal to the skip before run-in sections.

macros.name: runninghead
macros.doc: The \runninghead{⟨running-title⟩} modifier overrides a text going to the running head when a new non-starred section starts and an appropriate \pagestyle is in use.

macros.name: RunningSectionSuffix
macros.doc: The \RunningSectionSuffix{⟨suffix⟩} command specifies a suffix inserted after a running section title right before the skip after section.

macros.name: sectionstyle
macros.doc: The \sectionstyle[⟨type⟩]{⟨style⟩} changes a style for display sections of the given ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: sectiontagsuffix
macros.doc: \sectiontagsuffix[⟨type⟩]{⟨suffix⟩} changes a suffix after section tag that will be used for sections of the given ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: SectionTagSuffix
macros.doc: The \SectionTagSuffix{⟨suffix⟩} command specifies a default suffix inserted after a section number tag.

macros.name: SetTOCStyle
macros.doc: The \SetTOCStyle{⟨declarations⟩} command allows customize the table of contents and other content lists.

macros.name: skipwritingtoaux
macros.doc: The \skipwritingtoaux suppresses writing to aux-file for the next section command.

macros.name: StartFromTextArea
macros.doc: The \StartFromTextArea command prevents ignoring a vertical space at the beginning of page.

macros.name: TOCMarginDrift
macros.doc: The \TOCMarginDrift{⟨increment⟩} command specifies a value of rightmargin drift in TOCs.
